notes.title: Let's Puzzle Patch 2.3
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We're excited to announce Let's Puzzle Patch 2.3! Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*] [b]Enhanced Stability: [/b]We've made numerous tweaks under the hood to ensure that your puzzling experience is smoother and more reliable than ever.
[*] [b]Upgraded Video API: [/b]By upgrading our video API, we've boosted the game's performance, allowing for a more seamless and enjoyable gaming experience.
[*] [b]New Puzzle Sorting: [/b]Sort your puzzles with new categories in the selection screen. You can now show only custom puzzles, only normal puzzles and both of those depending on the DLC packages you select.
[/list]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41458989/9d95c6d87daa470ca5b817721ee70a0fb2bf3ea2.png[/img]

Thank you for your continued support and happy puzzling!

notes.title: Let's Puzzle - Celestial Realms, is now available!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the launch of our newest downloadable content (DLC) for Let's Puzzle!, titled Celestial Realms. This DLC expands your puzzle universe into the vastness of space, offering new challenges and visuals that will transport your gaming experience to otherworldly realms.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2931100/Lets_Puzzle__Celestial_Wonders_Pack/][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41458989/f17c3cbc9534895aff9a2233ceb431bc4aeef643.jpg[/img][/url]


[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Galactic Puzzle Designs:[/b] Engage with a variety of space-themed puzzles ranging from space dragons to mesmerizing black holes and intricate alien landscapes.
[*] [b]Celestial Interface:[/b] Transform your game with new in-game buttons shaped like galaxies and a star-themed interface, making every click a journey through space.
[*] [b]Custom Soundtrack:[/b] Immerse yourself in the depths of space with a completely new, custom soundtrack designed to match the serene yet awe-inspiring theme of the cosmos.
[*] [b]Enhanced Backgrounds:[/b] Choose from several new menu backgrounds that celebrate the beauty and mystery of the celestial realms, enhancing your gameplay atmosphere.
[/list]

[h2]Why Upgrade?[/h2]
Celestial Realms doesn't just add content; it transforms your game, making each puzzle not only a challenge but also a journey through the cosmos. With newly crafted designs and a soundtrack that resonates with the theme of exploration and wonder, this DLC offers a refreshing twist to your puzzle-solving quests. And it even gets better since the DLC will be improved over time by us to keep your experience fresh.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41458989/ab20ea7675614e9a344ed9d1e27b98cdb4ef3bc9.png[/img]

[h2]Availability[/h2]
Celestial Realms is now available for purchase on Steam. Elevate your puzzle experience by embracing the cosmos and uncovering the secrets of the universe with every piece you place.

notes.title: Let's Puzzle Patch 2.2
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We're excited to announce Let's Puzzle Patch 2.2! Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*] [b]Enhanced Stability[/b]: We've massively improved game stability by introducing separate previews for each puzzle, including Video Puzzles which did not have one before! Don’t worry about losing your existing custom puzzles, they're safe.
[*] [b]Custom User Interfaces[/b]: This update allows for the integration of extra game packages and DLCs, offering you fresh ways to customize the game's appearance.
[*] [b]Improved Menu and Loading Times[/b]: We've made significant improvements to the menu responsiveness and reduced loading times at game start.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these updates as much as we enjoyed developing them. Happy puzzling!

notes.title: Let's Puzzle - Version 2.0 Release
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Attention, Puzzle Enthusiasts![/b][/h1]

We are thrilled to announce significant updates to Let's Puzzle. After a period of silence, we've made comprehensive enhancements to ensure an even more engaging and seamless experience for you. Here's what's new:

[b]Enhanced Stability:[/b] We've meticulously optimized the game's performance to provide a smoother, more reliable gaming experience.

[b]Upgraded Visuals:[/b] Enjoy refined assets and graphics, bringing a fresh, more immersive visual appeal to your puzzle-solving adventures.

[b]Steam Rich Presence Integration:[/b] Now, your friends can see your in-game activities in real-time, making it easier to share your progress and achievements.

[b]Improved Menu Navigation:[/b] We've overhauled the menu interfaces, ensuring that you can navigate through options more intuitively and effortlessly.

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

This update is just the beginning. We are already working on additional features to enrich your gaming experience further. Stay connected for more announcements on what the future holds.

Thank you for your continued support and patience. We can't wait for you to dive back into the game and explore all the new improvements we've made. Happy puzzling!

notes.title: Update 1.4 With More Personalization And Improvements
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to Let's Puzzle 1.4[/h1]

Dear puzzle enthusiasts, with this update Let's Puzzle undergoes many changes that make the game more stable, faster and easier to personalize.

So let's go over the new features and improvements:

[h2]New features: [/h2]
- You can now set your own backgrounds, which will be attached to the front of the already existing backgrounds
- There is now more choice of puzzle sizes to allow easier puzzles as well

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
- Puzzles are now loaded via multithreading, so loading times are significantly reduced
- Menus are now much more relaxed to navigate with the help of new animations
- Performance when navigating through menus has been significantly improved

[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
- Fixed a bug that caused parts to be moved for other players even though they were no longer in the hand of the main player
- Fixed a bug that reset the lobby settings when closing the lobby for a short time
- Fixed a bug that caused all graphics settings to be saved either badly or not at all

And as always,
[b]Thanks for playing my game :)![/b]

notes.title: Update 1.2 Released
notes.notes:
This update contains two changes to Let's Puzzle which I implemented after requests from you. 

[b]Features:[/b] 
- You can now select multiple pieces at once to give you even more ways to solve puzzles.
- When saving a puzzle, all positions of puzzle pieces are now saved with it. So you don't have to rearrange your pieces and can continue where you left off.

[b]Visuals:[/b]
- The colors of the loading screen and logos have been adjusted to match the Steam store page.

notes.title: Update 1.1 Released
notes.notes:
In this update I would like to introduce you to two new features that have been added to [b]Let's Puzzle[/b]:

- [b]Mosaic Puzzles:[/b] You will now be able to play puzzles where all pieces will have the same shape. This way even the best of you will meet their limits. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41458989/c053c205a6b70b566f82c96142760f47ef6fd471.png[/img]

- [b]Animated Puzzles:[/b] In this patch I implemented 2 puzzles that already include animated images. If you are interested in the way this feature will evolve I reccomend checking out puzzles with the "Animated" Category. I will slowly add more images in mini-patches that will support animations/effects. 

[i][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/i]
- Fixed a bug where some people would see a warped image caused by miscalculations in the puzzle piece shaders
- Fixed a bug regarding the lobby menu where a lobby would show up multiple times when refreshing
- Fixed a bug where a saved game could only be resumed after restarting the game
- Fixed a bug where players would not recceive the achivement for solving a 1000-piece puzzle.

[i][b]Coming Soon:[/b][/i]
- Custom Animated Puzzles
- Puzzles with randomly rotated pieces
- New achivements

[i]And as always:[/i]
[b]Thank you so much for playing my game ːsteamhappyː[/b]
